basemaps.name: Relief

attribution: AWS Terrain Tiles (USGS, SRTM and others)

basemaps.name: Plain
basemaps.description: No background map: only the data, on a plain ground.

basemaps.name: Topo
basemaps.description: Land cover, water and roads in a topographic palette, with hill shading from open terrain data.
attribution: AWS Terrain Tiles (USGS, SRTM and others)

basemaps.name: Satellite
basemaps.description: Aerial imagery: USGS NAIP in the US, Esri World Imagery elsewhere. Needs a connection.

sources.name: Esri World Imagery
attribution: Powered by Esri. Source: Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community

labels.note: Town and road names from our vector tiles, drawn over the imagery inside the basemap extract.

attribution: Powered by Esri. Source: Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community

legend.label: Region outline
legend.detail: The edge of a MeshSonar region.

layers.name: Estimated between drives
layers.hint: A best guess for places nobody has driven, within 1 km of a measurement.

legend.label: Estimated, not driven
legend.detail: Striped cells are an estimate from nearby measured cells. They get fainter further from a measurement.

layers.name: Heard in passing
layers.hint: Places where a MeshSonar phone heard a repeater without sending a ping.

legend.label: Heard in passing
legend.detail: A phone heard a repeater here without pinging. The outline is the colour of the average signal it heard. It is not a measurement.

layers.name: Measured coverage

legend.label: Signal strength
legend.detail: The average signal of the pings in each cell, from weak to strong.

legend.label: No reply
legend.detail: A ping was sent here and no repeater answered.

legend.label: Heard, no direct signal
legend.detail: A ping was answered here, but no signal strength was recorded for it.

legend.label: Few pings
legend.detail: A faint cell has under 3 pings, so it is less certain.

layers.hint: Places someone drove and pinged from.

layers.name: Backup coverage

source.endpoint: /api/cmh/region-link-graph?sources=measured&drive=1 (drive rows: [repeaterIdx, h3, attempts, snrMean], count distinct repeaterIdx per h3)

layers.hint: How many repeaters reach each place. One means there is no backup.

legend.label: 1 repeater
legend.detail: Only one repeater was measured here: if it goes down, there is no coverage.

legend.label: 2 repeaters
legend.detail: Two repeaters were measured here.

legend.label: 3 repeaters
legend.detail: Three repeaters were measured here.

legend.label: 4 or more
legend.detail: Four or more repeaters were measured here.

layers.name: This drive

source.what: a drive's res-11 mean cells and pings

legend.label: Ping answered
legend.detail: A repeater answered this ping. The colour is its signal strength.

legend.label: Ping, no reply
legend.detail: No repeater answered this ping.

layers.hint: Your pings from this drive, in the same cells and colours.

layers.name: Link quality

source.endpoint: /api/cmh/region-link-graph?drive=0 (link rows: [aIdx, bIdx, source, width, snrDb, snrN, rssi, n, feeds, mix, lastAt, km])

layers.hint: Lines between repeaters that hear each other. Colour is the signal, width is how busy the link is.

legend.label: Link signal
legend.detail: The signal strength one repeater reports for another.

legend.label: Link, no reading
legend.detail: The two repeaters pass packets to each other, but neither reported a signal strength. Width is how many packets.

layers.name: Lines when I tap
layers.hint: Tap a repeater or a cell to see what it reaches.

legend.label: Link line
legend.detail: From the repeater or cell you tapped to what it reaches. The label is the signal strength.

layers.name: Repeaters everywhere
layers.hint: Every repeater in the country, not only this region (loads about 4 MB).

layers.name: Live packets

legend.label: Packet in flight
legend.detail: A packet travelling from repeater to repeater right now.

layers.hint: Packets crossing the mesh right now.

legend.label: Heard today
legend.detail: Heard in the last 24 hours: a solid ring.

legend.label: Heard this week
legend.detail: Heard in the last 7 days: a dashed ring.

legend.label: Not heard lately
legend.detail: Not heard for over 7 days: faded, no ring.

controls.name: Names
controls.hint: Name beside each repeater, from street zoom (z14); fewer when crowded.

layers.name: Estimated positions
layers.hint: Repeaters that do not share a position, placed from the repeaters they hear. Paler means less sure.

legend.label: Estimated position
legend.detail: This repeater shares no position. It is placed from 3 or more repeaters it hears, so it is approximate.

legend.label: Rough estimate
legend.detail: Placed from only one or two repeaters, or ones far apart, so it is less sure.

layers.name: Listening stations

legend.label: Station, online
legend.detail: A listening station (observer) that is reporting now.

legend.label: Station, offline
legend.detail: A listening station (observer) that has stopped reporting.

layers.hint: Radios that listen all day and report what they hear (observers).

layers.name: Phones on the move
layers.hint: MeshSonar phones listening while they travel, shown only to about 5 km.

legend.label: Phone on the move
legend.detail: A MeshSonar phone listening while it travels. The spot is approximate (about 5 km) and fades 10 minutes after it was last heard.

layers.name: Plan

source.what: the plan's planned nodes, their predicted footprints and planned links (client-drawn from the plan JSON)

layers.hint: Your planned repeaters and links. A prediction, not a measurement.

legend.label: Planned repeater
legend.detail: A repeater in your plan. The dashed ring means it is not built yet.

legend.label: Predicted signal
legend.detail: The signal the planned repeaters are predicted to give.

legend.label: Planned link
legend.detail: The colour says how likely the link is to work. It is dashed because it is a model.

layers.name: Route

source.what: the page's path: hops in order, each with a number, a name, and whether its position is certain

layers.hint: The route a page is showing.

legend.label: Hop, in order
legend.detail: Each hop is numbered in the order the packet took: number, then name.

legend.label: Known hop
legend.detail: A solid line joins two hops whose positions are known for sure.

legend.label: Likely hop
legend.detail: A dashed line goes to a hop that is the best match, not proven. Hops with no position are listed, not drawn.

source.what: the point a tool asks for

legend.label: Picked point
legend.detail: The point you picked.

layers.name: Predicted footprint

source.what: the painter's predicted footprint from one site (margin over the floor, the five signal bands)

layers.hint: Predicted from one site. A model, not a measurement.

legend.label: Predicted signal
legend.detail: Predicted from this site in 5 dB steps above the weakest signal a radio can use. Places below that are not shaded.

layers.name: Drive track

source.what: a drive's line and ping dots; the part the public does not see is dashed

legend.label: Ping answered
legend.detail: A repeater answered this ping. The colour is its signal strength.

legend.label: Ping, no reply
legend.detail: No repeater answered this ping.

legend.label: Hidden part
legend.detail: The part of the drive the public does not see: faded and dashed.

layers.hint: The line of a drive and its pings.

layers.name: Privacy zones

source.what: the account's privacy zones: a dashed circle each, numbered

legend.label: Privacy zone
legend.detail: Pings inside this circle are never shown to the public.

layers.hint: Places you chose to keep off the public map.

source.what: the boundary review's candidate outline and the nodes it gains or loses (admin only)

legend.label: Candidate boundary
legend.detail: A proposed new edge for the region (moderators only).

palettes.name: Standard
palettes.blurb: Red to yellow to green for signal strength. Dark slate where nothing answered.

palettes.name: Colour-blind safe
palettes.blurb: Orange and yellow for weak, light blue and blue for strong, never red against green. Dark slate where nothing answered. Link lines are dashed.

confidence.high: 3 or more located neighbours, all within 15 km of each other
confidence.medium: 2 or more located neighbours within 40 km of each other (3 or more spread over 15 to 40 km, or 2)
confidence.low: 1 located neighbour, or neighbours more than 40 km apart

labels: 1 repeater: a single point of failure

roles.label: Role not known yet: a diamond

status.label: Active: heard as often as usual
Heard less often: still heard, but less than usual
Not heard lately: nothing heard for longer than usual
Not known yet: not enough history to say

hash.label: Uses a 2- or 3-byte hash: its hops read clearly in paths
Uses a 1-byte hash: its hops can be confused with others
Seen with more than one hash size

important.label: Important link: the mesh would split without it, or it joins two critical nodes
important.nodeLabel: Critical node: losing it cuts part of the mesh off (ring)

neighbour.label: Direct neighbour of the selected node (line from it)

roles.name: Repeater
roles.label: Repeater: a tower in a circle

roles.name: Sensor
roles.label: Sensor: a small circle with a dot

roles.name: Role not known
roles.label: Role not known yet: a diamond

roles.name: Observer
roles.label: Observer: an eye on a mast

roles.name: Moving phone
roles.label: Moving MeshSonar phone (approximate, ~5 km; fades 10 min after last heard)

status.label: Active: heard as often as usual
Heard less often: still heard, but less than usual
Not heard lately: nothing heard for longer than usual
Not known yet: not enough history to say

hash.label: Uses a 2- or 3-byte hash: its hops read clearly in paths
Uses a 1-byte hash: its hops can be confused with others
Seen with more than one hash size

certainty.label: Certain hop: its position is known
Likely hop: the best match, not proven

path.label: {n} · {name}
path.unplacedNote: Hops with no known position are listed, never drawn, and the line stops there.

hiddenTrack.label: Hidden from the public: faded and dashed

things.note: a repeater heard right now on a drive

switches.name: Hash prefix
switches.note: on by default on the Network Map page

time.note: Predicted coverage and Heard by phones are all-time and hide while a time window is picked.

growth.label: Coverage growth (as of)
growth.note: Predicted coverage and Heard by phones are all-time and hide while an earlier day is picked.

predicted.o: opacity 0.15-0.6 (fades with distance from the nearest measurement)

heard.band: 1-6, band of the mean heard SNR (same SF rule as measured)
heard.n: receptions heard by phones in the cell

properties.h: H3 id of the summary cell
H3 id of the summary cell

options.label: Scope
options.note: No scope data from the network yet: this fills in once nodes report their scopes.

pingColour.note: The Drive map's ping dots; the website has no pings on this map.

sections.name: Signal coverage
sections.hint: Where a radio can reach a repeater.

sections.name: Repeaters
sections.hint: The radios that pass messages on.

sections.name: People and listeners
sections.hint: Listening stations, phones and your friends.

sections.name: Filters
sections.hint: Show only part of the data.

extras.label: Your position
extras.detail: Where your phone is now. The arrow points the way you are heading.

extras.label: Heard this drive
extras.detail: A tick on a repeater that answered at least one of your pings on this drive.

extras.label: Several repeaters
extras.detail: The number is how many repeaters are close together here. Zoom in to see each one.

extras.label: Selected
extras.detail: The ring marks the one you tapped.

extras.label: Room server
extras.detail: A rounded square is a room server: a radio that keeps a shared message board.

extras.label: Friend
extras.detail: A friend who shares their position with you in a MeshTrack group.

extras.label: Meet point
extras.detail: The meeting place your MeshTrack group set.

styles.label: Known hop
styles.detail: The repeater that passed the packet on is known for sure.

styles.label: Likely hop
styles.detail: The best match for a hop that several repeaters could be.

styles.label: Hop nobody can place
styles.detail: A hop that matches no repeater with a known position. Drawn faint.
